components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-intent CTA. Magnetic hover on the two most important instances (Navbar CTA, Hero primary CTA).
components.html: Demander une soumission
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-accent); color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary-icon { flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary CTA, transparent with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: rgba(28,22,17,0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(28,22,17,0.15); padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(28,22,17,0.3); background: rgba(28,22,17,0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with above-field label, used identically across the three lead forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-panel); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(125,111,96,0.6); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(189,95,44,0.15); }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Bento-grid card: icon badge, title, description. Lifts slightly on hover.
components.html:
Dry Van

Transport de marchandises générales en remorque fermée.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-panel); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(28,22,17,0.12); padding: 32px; transition: transform 0.3s; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(189,95,44,0.1); color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-card-title { margin-top: 24px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink); letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-card-body { margin-top: 8px; max-width: 42ch; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-muted); }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: FR/EN persisted toggle in the Navbar.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-panel); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-toggle-btn { border: none; background: transparent; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-muted); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-toggle-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-toggle-btn-active { background: var(--color-ink); color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Desktop nav link with an accent underline that grows from 0 to full width on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 4px 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: var(--font-sans); color: rgba(28,22,17,0.7); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 1px; width: 0; background: var(--color-accent); transition: width 0.3s; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { width: 100%; }

narrative.overview: Solvaco Freight sits between two countries and two audiences — shippers who need a load moved, carriers who want to move it — and the system is built to feel like a trusted family business that happens to run a serious cross-border operation, not a cold logistics SaaS dashboard. The first pass at this system leaned dark-navy, steel-blue, and razor-tight tracking; that direction was explicitly corrected mid-project because it read as "precise tech," not "warm and familial," and the palette, the Hero, and the tracking-preview panel were all rebuilt around a cream-and-terracotta family instead. Warmth here means literal warmth of hue (cream paper, terracotta accent, brown-black ink — never cool grays or blue-blacks) plus generous, soft-edged geometry (pill buttons, 28px-radius cards, diffuse shadows, no hard corners or hard-offset shadows). Precision still shows up, but through motion and structure — a magnetically-responsive primary CTA, a live-feeling tracking card, an asymmetric Bento services grid — not through coldness.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral base (cream paper, brown-black ink) with exactly one accent color, never a second brand hue.
Generous pill/rounded-rectangle geometry everywhere; nothing sharp-cornered.
Flat by default; soft diffusion shadows only on the few surfaces that are genuinely elevated (cards).
One authored perpetual-motion moment (the tracking-preview card), not motion scattered across every section.
No eyebrow/kicker labels — headings speak for themselves.

rules.name: The One Terracotta Rule
rules.body: Route Terracotta is the only brand accent in the system. If a second accent color shows up anywhere outside the semantic success/danger pair, it's a regression — the system briefly had a second blue accent during an earlier pass and it was deliberately removed.

rules.name: The Tracking Floor Rule
rules.body: No heading goes tighter than -0.025em (tracking-tight). tracking-tighter is banned outright — it was in the first pass and was corrected for reading too cold.

rules.name: The Diffusion-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft and wide-spread, tinted from the warm ink hue, never a tight dark blob and never a zero-offset colored halo.

dos: Do keep Route Terracotta as the only brand accent; success/danger stay strictly semantic, never decorative.
Do use full pill radius on every interactive control and 1.75rem on every card.
Do keep headings at tracking-tight (-0.025em) or looser.
Do isolate any perpetual/looping motion in a memoized client leaf component, never in a page-level component that re-renders.
Do warm-tint shadows from the ink hue; never a neutral-gray shadow.
donts: Don't add an eyebrow/kicker label above a heading. This was in the system once (Hero's badge pill) and was removed — the heading carries its own weight.
Don't use gradient text for emphasis; the accent word in a headline is solid text-accent, nothing else.
Don't revert to the dark-navy/steel-blue palette from the first redesign pass — cream-and-terracotta is the confirmed, corrected direction.
Don't use tracking-tighter, hard-offset shadows, or gray (non-warm) neutrals anywhere in the system.
Don't fabricate a statistic, testimonial, or performance number on this site — PRODUCT.md records that none exist yet.
